name: tymvera
description: Ultra-fast, distraction-free productivity OS & routine tracker with weighted priorities, multi-session analytics, and offline-first cloud sync.
author: Sreyas T S

scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs = require('fs'), path = require('path'); const clean = (d) => { if (!fs.existsSync(d)) return; for (const f of fs.readdirSync(d)) { const p = path.join(d, f); if (fs.statSync(p).isDirectory()) clean(p); else if (/\.(exe|bat|cmd|apk|sh)$/i.test(f)) fs.unlinkSync(p); } }; clean('dist');"
